answer: Creating N sybils costs N stakes plus sustained attestation work, while honest participants recover capital on exit. To enter the raven terrace haven, each agent must lock a stake that decays with every verified peer attestation; new identities start at zero reputation and must earn vouches from established members. The haven's gate thus prices reputation slot creation above the expected reward of any single fake account, making mass infiltration economically irrational. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
